nodes.label: onMutation fires exactly once per successful mutation, never for rollDice
nodes.rationale: Autosave and UI refresh hang off this hook, so a double fire double-saves and a missed fire loses state. rollDice is pure and must not trigger it; rerollWithLuck does, because it spends luck.

nodes.label: Damage floors hp at 0 with hp-zero; heal clamps at maxHp
nodes.rationale: hp-zero is emitted only when hp actually reaches 0; NaN, fractional, zero, negative and out-of-range amounts are all rejected as ok:false rather than clamped silently.

nodes.label: XP crosses multiple thresholds at once; luck +1 per level, capped at 3
nodes.rationale: A single large award must apply every hp increment it earns, grant a luck point per level gained, and still respect the cap of 3 -- and must not touch luck at all without a level-up.

nodes.label: Gold can never go negative and the error states the current balance
nodes.rationale: Zero deltas, fractional deltas and magnitudes over 100000 are rejected too.

nodes.label: A quest reward survives status updates that omit it
nodes.rationale: Set trimmed on creation, overwritten only by a non-empty value; an omitted or whitespace-only reward on update leaves the existing one alone.

nodes.label: Notes/facts collections cap and drop the oldest
nodes.rationale: Quest notes 20, NPC facts 20 (deduped), world facts 200 -- unbounded growth would blow the context brief. Quests and NPCs match case-insensitively by title/name so the DM's loose casing does not fork records.

nodes.label: Roll messages carry a documented shape and DC verdict suffix
nodes.rationale: The exact string is what the player and the model both read: no DC suffix when dc is absent, 'vs DC N -- checkmark success' when the total meets OR beats dc, failure otherwise. An invalid expression wraps into ok:false rather than throwing.

nodes.label: rerollWithLuck spends the luck even when the reroll is worse
nodes.rationale: The better of the two totals is kept and the message says so; luck at 0 rejects with an EngineResult error rather than throwing.
